title: Pure Shiranui
summary: Shiranui cards only, with generic Links and staples. Shiranui are FIRE Zombies with 0 DEF that do their best work when banished. Shiranui Spectralsword banishes itself and another Zombie from the GY to summon a Zombie Synchro of their combined Level, and each banished Shiranui then triggers. Spiritmaster destroys a card, Samurai recovers a Shiranui, and Solitaire revives banished Shiranui. Shiranui Solitaire tributes a Zombie for a 0-DEF Zombie Tuner from the Deck, and Shiranui Squire summons a Spectralsword from the hand or Deck. Shiranui Sunsaga returns banished Synchros to destroy their cards, and Shiranui Skillsaga Supremacy brings banished Synchros back on their turn. Ghost Meets Girl - A Masterful Mayakashi Shiranui Saga, the newest card, tributes a Shiranui Synchro to stop all Special Summons for the turn. Squire limits you to Zombies for the turn.

allow.Ghost Meets Girl - A Masterful Mayakashi: Names Shiranui: tributes a Shiranui Synchro or Link Monster.

main: Shiranui Solitaire
Starter: tributes a Zombie for a 0-DEF Zombie Tuner; revives banished Shiranui.
Shiranui Squire
Summons a Spectralsword from the hand or Deck; loots when banished.
Shiranui Spectralsword
Tuner: banishes itself and a Zombie from the GY for a matching Zombie Synchro.
Shiranui Spectralsword Shade
Tuner: tributes itself to revive two banished Zombies.
Shiranui Spiritmaster
Revives a Shiranui on Normal Summon; destroys a card when banished.
Shiranui Samurai
Banishes Zombies for ATK; recovers a Shiranui when banished.
Shiranui Smith
Searches a Shiranui card as Synchro material.
Shiranui Swordmaster
Revives itself next to two Shiranui; pumps a Zombie when banished.
Shiranui Style Synthesis
Field Spell: revives a 0-DEF Zombie onto an empty board.
Shiranui Style Solemnity
Counts as Synthesis; makes Zombie summons unnegatable or banishes one.
Ghost Meets Girl - A Shiranui's Story
Quick-Play: discards a Zombie to summon a Shiranui from the Deck or GY.
Shiranui Style Success
Summons a Zombie from the hand; makes one unaffected from the GY.
Shiranui Style Swallow's Slash
Tributes a Zombie to destroy two cards; banishes a Shiranui from the Deck.
Shiranui Style Samsara
Counts as Synthesis; prevents damage or recycles banished Zombies to draw.
Ghost Meets Girl - A Masterful Mayakashi Shiranui Saga
Newest: tributes a Shiranui Synchro to stop all Special Summons for the turn.
Fateful Hour
Revives a Shiranui Synchro from either GY.
extra: Level 7: banishes a monster for ATK and Spell/Trap removal.
Level 5: changes a position; leaves a Token when banished.
Level 6: shuffles a banished Zombie back to shrink their board.
Level 8: banishes a Zombie for ATK; revives a banished Zombie.
Link-3: protects your Synchros; summons banished Synchros on their turn.
Level 10: returns banished Synchros to destroy their cards.
